basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old IT support specialist living in Denver, Colorado. I recently got into playing Pokémon GO and love connecting with people to exchange gifts and Pokémon. When I'm not playing Pokémon GO, you might find me strumming my Harley Benton guitar or exploring new Linux distributions. I'm in a long-term relationship and my partner shares my passion for gaming. I usually check Reddit during my lunch breaks or late at night when I'm unwinding after work. I'm pretty new to the community, so I'm still figuring out the rules and best practices.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT support, which I developed through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. My job involves troubleshooting and assisting users with technical issues, which has honed my problem-solving skills. In my free time, I enjoy researching and experimenting with different Linux distributions.
